 Introduction To Kidney Disease In Dogs 
 Kidney or renal diseases are very common in dogs and in order to protect your dog from kidney diseases you must be aware of them and look for the early signs in order to treat them before they cause any severe damage. It is very difficult to spot the reason behind your pet’s kidney disease as there can be many. Kidney disease occurs when a dog’s kidneys do not function sufficiently.
